incident.truth_gap_cause: Event truth retained the first 30 and newest 30 one-second samples, deleting the middle of long passes; no pre-trigger truth history was copied into a new event.
incident.deleted_pointer_cause: No production recorder retention or prune unit was found. Historical ledger rows remained immutable after external/manual recording removal.
incident.initial_integrity_failure: The API raced native sidecar publication and could not reopen legacy 0600 processor-owned files.
incident.receiver_reconciliation: Suite had reset per-channel gains to five values of 2.7 dB. Safe Apply issued only set_channel_gains and verified authoritative readback before processor start. Frequency, rate, channel count, coherent mode and physical mapping were unchanged.

fix.integrity: Independent SHA-256 of IQ and native sidecar after a bounded publication retry; native streaming SHA remains a fail-closed compatibility path for older 0600 files.
fix.shared_clip_semantics: The clip is admitted when integrity is valid and at least one target has complete CPI truth. Each incomplete co-resident target remains quarantined.
fix.health: Persistent admitted/quarantined/reason counters plus missing-after-admission audit.
